name: kev-api-client
description: Generate a typed TypeScript client for the KEV FastAPI backend (pattern from tools/fastapi-typescript)

scripts.api-build: node fetch-openapi.cjs && openapi-generator-cli generate -i ../../src/generated/api/openapi.json -g typescript-fetch -o ../../src/generated/api --additional-properties=stringEnums=true,removeEnumValuePrefix=false --global-property supportingFiles,models,apis=Core
